title: Promote fusion only through architecture and shape conditioned dispatch

source.title: SGLang PR #26089 cross-architecture FP8 fusion
source.claim_scope: The source reports opposite end-to-end signs on H100 and B200; target dispatch requires independent reproduction.

implementation_recipe: Fuse one adjacent producer-consumer pair while preserving an unfused fallback.
Gate selection by backend, quantization mode, architecture and measured shape frontier.
Keep return types and output dtypes identical for every fallback consumer.
validation_recipe: Measure per-shape on every supported architecture rather than extrapolating.
Check end-to-end accuracy and operator outputs.
expected_bottleneck_shifts: Removed launches and intermediates can expose register pressure, occupancy and compiler scheduling differences that reverse the gain.
failure_modes: Unconditional fused dispatch changes ABI for unrelated models.
A kernel profitable on one GPU generation regresses another.
Hard-coded output dtype changes downstream numerics.
scope_limits: No universal fusion claim is allowed from one architecture or aggregate workload.

algorithmic_decomposition.baseline_dependency: A producer materializes an intermediate that a quantizing or transforming consumer reads.
algorithmic_decomposition.combine_rule: Compute producer values inside the consumer tile and retain only consumer output.
algorithmic_decomposition.finalization: Dispatch to fused or unfused implementation using a measured hardware-shape frontier.
algorithmic_decomposition.work_complexity: Arithmetic work is similar; global intermediate traffic and one launch are removed.
algorithmic_decomposition.span_complexity: One launch replaces two sequential launches.
algorithmic_decomposition.communication_cost: Intermediate global-memory round trip is removed.
anti_patterns: fusing unrelated optional paths in one patch

candidate_archetypes.name: hardware-shape gated adjacent fusion
candidate_archetypes.template: Fuse the adjacent pair, retain the original path, and select only target hardware-shape cells that pass correctness and regression guards.
